csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: Project Development Services - Small Structure Replacement on I-74, 9.19 miles East of the Marion/Shelby County Line. The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents in accordance with the INDOT project development process. The selected firm shall complete Road Design (if needed), Small Culverts and Hydraulics Design, Ecological Survey, Environmental Documentation, Permits Applications, Utility Coordination, Topographic Survey and Construction Phase Services. Other services such as Right-of-Way Plan Development (including R/W Engineering, Title Research and Staking, if needed), Archeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigation, wetland mitigation, professional public outreach and marketing services, may be included later if these work types become necessary
